definitions.title: Arc Length of a Smooth Space Curve
definitions.statement: The arc length L of a smooth space curve r(t) on [a, b] is the integral of speed with respect to time. It is intrinsically independent of the specific parametrization chosen.
definitions.explanation: Approximated by sums of polygonal segment lengths, converging to the Riemann integral of |v(t)|.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Arc length measures the total geometric distance traversed along the curved path.

definitions.title: Arc Length Parameter and Unit Speed
definitions.statement: The arc length parameter s(t) measures directed distance along the curve from a designated reference point t_0. Parametrizing a curve with respect to s produces unit speed: |dr/ds| = 1.
definitions.explanation: By the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, ds/dt is speed. Inverting t = t(s) yields the natural unit-speed parametrization.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Reparametrization by arc length isolates intrinsic geometry from speed of traversal.
